title: OL-20261115-25: Required licence files missing in five repos
body:
**Owner:** portfolio-manager
**Trigger:** daily lane sweep and any change to doctrine/publication.json
**Done check:** grep:ops/publication/ledger.jsonl::"seed": "clean"
**Status:** open

Measured 2026-11-15 by `publication --audit --org`: .github lacks LICENSE, NOTICE, COMMERCIAL-TERMS.md, CITATION.cff; license lacks NOTICE, CITATION.cff, SECURITY.md; spec lacks LICENSE, SECURITY.md; seed and ops lack all five. Each repo is refused until its files are present (copies from the license repo, text unchanged). Default in effect: those repos are not flipped.
